title: [VCB-Studio] Overflow / おーばーふろぉ 10-bit 1080p HEVC BDRip [Fin]
description:
![Overflow_1_800.webp](https://img.2222.moe/images/2022/11/14/Overflow_1_800.webp)
  
Overflow / おーばーふろぉ BDRip
10-bit 1080p HEVC + FLAC，MKV 格式。每话约 300 MB。
10-bit 1080p HEVC + FLAC, MKV format. ~ 300 MB / EP.

原盘画质较好，原生分辨率为 810p，线条有轻微的锯齿和振铃，四周还有轻微烂边。平面覆盖着一层高强度的细密静噪点，基本上没产生什么色带。我们的处理手段是常规的逆向拉伸重构、轻微去色带、补偿性锐化和自适应降噪。
The source quality is better than average, with a native resolution of 810p. There are slight aliasing and ringing around the lines and also several dirty edges around the image. The flat area is covered by high-intensity fine static noise, thus little colour banding is found. Our PP: routine descaling and reconstruction, slight de-banding, compensatory sharpening and adaptive denoising.

SPs 文件夹内含有 Uncensored 版本，此版本将 BD 中有码片段替换为 coolmic 的无码 web 版本。这个无码的源已经烂完了。帧率是奇怪的 23.970，被搞得一团糟，经常缺帧或者有重复帧；matrix 也被搞错了，导致画面有偏色；超低码率导致了严重的编码瑕疵和细节损失；被劣质算法缩小到了 720p，导致线条有非常严重的锯齿和振铃，同时损失了大量高频细节；还有硬字幕和水印。我们只能说是尽力而为了，首先使用了神经网络算法去除编码瑕疵，然后使用了另一个神经网络算法拉升到 1080p，同时去除锯齿和振铃，并尽量修复了偏色的问题。最后对一些片段进行了 dehardsub 和 delogo 处理。由于这个帧率被搞乱的原因，所以有些高动态片段难以对齐，还有些片段是马赛克和硬字幕重叠，这些片段我们也没什么好办法，只好保留了硬字幕。另外第六集的无码源在结尾处少了一段，所以第六集结尾一小段依然是有码的。
The SPs folder contains an uncensored version, which replaces the mosaic parts of BDRip with no-mosaic Web-DL released by coolmic.
But unfortunately, this no-mosaic WEB-DL is totally horrible:
a. strange frame rate, 23970/1000, not 24000/1001, leading to a mass of missing frames and duplicate frames;
b. wrong colour matrix, making the image rather off-coloured;
c. ultra-low bitrate, resulting in serious compression artifacts and detail loss;
d. poor downscaling(to 720p) algorithm, ending with lots of high-frequency detail loss, plus severe aliasing and ringing.
There are also hardsubs and logos in the image.
In truth, we had no choice but pulled out all the stops: first using a neural network algorithm to eliminate the compression artifacts, next adopting another neural network algorithm to upscale the Web-DL to 1080p while removing the aliasing and ringing, then fixing the off-coloured issue as much as possible. Our PP is finally ended with dehardsub and delogo.
Even still, some high-dynamic cuts are difficult to align thanks to the messed up frame rate while some others come with overlapping mosaics and hardsubs. There wasn't much we could do about these cuts, thus we kept the hardsubs. Also, the EP6 of Web-DL is missing a short part at the end, we, therefore, used the BDRip with the mosaics as the alternative.
